## Personality

Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) is an exceptionally hardworking, capable, and practical woman who manages her own affairs alongside those of others. Known as a meddlesome gossip and a critical, outspoken observer, she prides herself on speaking her mind freely without fear or favor. Despite her sharp tongue, she possesses a deeply kind soul and is a gently skillful, tender, and unwearied nurse when tending to the sick. She is a passionate political enthusiast, loves being asked for advice, and compulsively tries to correct and properly raise anyone she lives with. Additionally, she harbors a distinct prejudice against [Americans](../codex/factions.md#american), strongly opposes higher education for women, and holds dubious views regarding the propriety of writing fiction.

## History

Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) lived in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) as [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) Cuthbert's neighbor for forty-five years, having raised ten children, buried two, knitted sixteen cotton warp quilts, and mortgaged her farm eight years prior to help her youngest son move west. When she first learned [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) planned to adopt a child, she strongly voiced her disapproval, and she later engaged in a sharp dispute with young [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) after insulting the girl's appearance. Although [Anne](../character/anne.md) initially flew into a rage, she ultimately gave Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) a dramatic apology, which Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) accepted. Over time, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) became a frequent source of community advice and news at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), weighing in on local affairs, village improvements, and Anne's teaching career. Following the death of her husband, [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md), she accepted Marilla's proposal to move in at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), allowing [Anne](../character/anne.md) to leave for [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) while Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) helped manage the home and care for the young twins, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md). Throughout Anne's college years and return visits, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) remained a fixture at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), offering household guidance and keeping track of neighborhood gossip.

## Quotes

> "But really, Green Gables doesn’t seem as out of the world as it used to do . . . Anne has lots of company and the twins make it real lively. And anyhow, I’d rather live at the bottom of a well than leave Avonlea."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P27](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0027)

> "and as for the twins, I’ll be glad to do all I can for them; but I won’t undertake to answer Davy’s questions, that’s what. I’m not an encyclopedia, neither am I a Philadelphia lawyer. You’ll miss Anne for that."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P29](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0029)

> "I never saw her look so pleasant before, that’s what. Well, there weren’t many tears shed over her, poor old soul. The Elisha Wrights are thankful to be rid of her, and I can’t say I blame them a mite."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v3 ch.Evening P11](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0011)

> "though, mind you, there was a time I didn’t think so—that evening I came up to see Anne and she treated us to such a scene. Many things have changed since then, that’s what."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v4 CHAPTER 2 THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P2](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0002)

> "She’s terrible skinny and homely, Marilla. Come here, child, and let me have a look at you. Lawful heart, did any one ever see such freckles? And hair as red as carrots! Come here, child, I say."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014)

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--rachel-lynde.md)

Rachel initially clashed with [Anne](../character/anne.md) after visiting [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and making blunt insults about the girl's appearance, driving [Anne](../character/anne.md) into a furious rage. However, after [Anne](../character/anne.md) delivered a dramatic apology, Rachel completely forgave her and offered comforting advice. Over time, their hostility gave way to a warm relationship, with Rachel acting as a well-meaning older neighbor who shares local news and advises [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) on how to handle the growing girl.

- Enemy of — insulted Anne and faced intense mutual hostility  _(ended v1)_  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016)</sub>
- Friend of — well-meaning older neighbour and advisor (since v2)  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P54](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0054)</sub>

### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/marilla-cuthbert--rachel-lynde.md)

Rachel and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) share a longstanding neighborly friendship rooted in mutual trust and regular visits. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) confides in Rachel about major household decisions, such as adopting an orphan, while Rachel freely offers her strong opinions and practical advice on raising children. Though Rachel can be outspoken and critical, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) continues to value her counsel and companionship.

- Friend of — longstanding neighborly friendship  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P12](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ### [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/rachel-lynde--thomas-lynde.md)

[Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md) is Rachel's husband, living alongside her in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). While Rachel takes a very active and inquisitive role in community affairs, [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) remains quiet in the background of their household, though his ill health eventually becomes a topic of concern among their neighbors.

### [Emily](../character/emily.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/emily--rachel-lynde.md)

Rachel and [Emily](../character/emily.md) formed a friendship following Emily's sudden arrival in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) to reconcile with her estranged husband, Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md). Intrigued by the unexpected reunion, Rachel investigated the household news and subsequently established a close, lifelong bond with [Emily](../character/emily.md).

- Friend of — struck up a lifelong friendship (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P47](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0047)</sub>
